description: Find the nearest alternative fuel stations to a given US location (latitude/longitude). Includes EV charging (Level 1/2/DC Fast), CNG, LNG, propane, biodiesel, hydrogen. Returns station name, address, network, plug types, hours, last verified date. US-specific; for global EV stations use openchargemap.

fuel_type.description: Comma-separated fuel codes: ELEC (electric), CNG, LNG, LPG (propane), BD (biodiesel), E85, HY (hydrogen). Default ELEC.

latitude.description: WGS84 latitude (US territory only). Example: 37.7749 for San Francisco.

longitude.description: WGS84 longitude (US territory only). Example: -122.4194 for San Francisco.

status.description: Station status: E=available (open), P=planned (future), T=temporarily unavailable. Default E.

name: nrel.afdc.nearest

error.description: Present only when the call failed. Includes error code, message, request_id, and any provider-specific extras.

result.description: Tool response payload. Shape varies per tool — consult the tool description and inputSchema. May be an object, array, string, or number depending on the upstream provider response.

title: NREL AFDC — Nearest Alt-Fuel Stations
